inj_report.short: Spann-Ford caught one of three targets for 26 yards during the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Spann-Ford operated as the Cowboys' TE1 in Week 10 due to the absence of Jake Ferguson (knee). George Pickens, CeeDee Lamb and Ryan Flournoy were the top targets of Dak Prescott, With Spann-Ford and five other Cowboys skill-position players logging one catch each. Ferguson is expected to be sidelined for multiple weeks while recovering from his injury, so Spann-Ford should once again be the Cowboys' top tight end for Week 11 on Nov. 22, against a Titans team that has given up 40-plus points in each of its last two games.

inj_report.short: Dobbins rushed four times for 18 yards and caught his only target for four yards during Sunday's 26-21 win over Carolina.
inj_report.long: Dobbins saw 13 fewer carries than rookie running back Jonah Coleman (17-57-1) in the game. The four rushes were a season low for Dobbins, and he figures to continue to operate as the team's No. 2 option in the backfield moving forward.

inj_report.short: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Williams was a distant second to Stefon Diggs in receiving yards for the Commanders on the night, but like the latter, the former was on the receiving end of one of Jayden Daniels' three touchdown passes. Williams scored from 31 yards out just past the midway point of the third quarter, his first touchdown since way back in Week 1 against the Eagles. Williams hasn't been able to fully take advantage of the absence of Terry McLaurin (knee, IR) as of yet, but Thursday's score is certainly an encouraging sign heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Bengals on Monday night, Nov. 23.

inj_report.short: Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
inj_report.long: The five grabs and nine targets led the Broncos on the day, but Pat Bryant just edged him out for the receiving yards lead. The highlight of Sutton's solid performance was a three-yard TD from Bo Nix in the first quarter, as none of his receptions went for longer than 12 yards. Denver gets a well-timed bye in Week 10, but if Jaylen Waddle (concussion) isn't cleared to play on the other side of it, Sutton could see bigger volume in Week 11 against the Raiders. On the season, the long-time Bronco sports a 25-266-2 line on 46 targets through nine games.

inj_report.short: Hutchinson brought in four of nine targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Hutchinson, who was checked for a concussion during the fourth quarter, finished second across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets for the Texans. He also recorded a touchdown grab for the third straight game on an 11-yard catch early in the second quarter, and his receiving yardage tally was his highest since Week 5. Hutchinson now sports a 28-345-3 receiving line on 54 targets as he continues to function in a steady complementary role heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

inj_report.short: Johnston brought in his sole target for six yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.
inj_report.long: The speedster was poised to see some added involvement with Ladd McConkey (back) sidelined, but that never materialized on a night when 86 of Justin Herbert's 129 passing yards went to Tre' Harris. Johnston's yardage total was a season-low figure, and he's now been limited to one reception in four of the last five games. Johnston's often been able to offset the modest catch totals with big plays, but that clearly wasn't the case Monday night. Johnston will remain a hit-or-miss fantasy option in a Week 11 home matchup against the Jets on Sunday, irrespective of McConkey's availability.

inj_report.short: The Commanders designated Croskey-Merritt (groin) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.
inj_report.long: As a result of the transaction, the Commanders will have a 21-day window wherein they can evaluate Croskey-Merritt for a return to the 53-man roster. Depending on how he fares in practice during Week 11, Croskey-Merritt could be reinstated ahead of Monday's game against the Bengals. Whenever the Commanders elect to activate him, Croskey-Merritt will likely step back in as the team's lead runner, allowing Rachaad White to shift into more of a complementary role as the top pass-catching back.

inj_report.long: Freiermuth was added to the Steelers' injury report Saturday due to an illness that left him questionable for Week 10 action. Ultimately, he avoided inactive status and also made an end-zone visit for the first time since Week 5 on a 27-yard hookup with QB Aaron Rodgers in the fourth quarter. Considering Freiermuth hasn't reached 50 receiving yards in any game this season, he remains a TD-dependent fantasy option (five in his nine appearances).

inj_report.short: Demercado rushed seven times for 16 yards and brought in one of two targets for minus-1 yard in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Demercado opened the game as a reserve in his second appearance in a Texans uniform, but Woody Marks' third-quarter exit due to a concussion left the former in the de facto No. 1 role. That still didn't lead to much opportunity for Demercado in a game during which Houston squandered a 17-0 first-half lead. However, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN.com reports Marks is unlikely to play in Week 11 due to the short turnaround for a home matchup against the Colts, meaning Demercado and Dare Ogunbowale could have expanded roles in that game unless David Montgomery (groin) is able to suit up.

inj_report.long: After missing the previous two games with a knee injury, Spears returned to play 16 offensive snaps. Tony Pollard (41 snaps) remains the clear-cut lead back on this cellar-dwelling Tennessee team. Spears has minimal fantasy appeal now that Pollard survived the trade deadline and will finish out the season with the Titans.

inj_report.short: Dell brought in three of four targets for 21 yards and rushed once for no gain in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
inj_report.long: One week after posting a 105-yard effort against the Chargers in only his second game since 2024, Dell saw a big downturn in yardage Sunday. Nevertheless, the fact he retained a solid complementary role was encouraging, and the speedy wideout seems to be playing unencumbered by any physical or mental limitations following the recovery from his devastating knee injury. Dell will look to boost his yardage back up in a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Colts on Thursday night.

inj_report.short: Perine turned six carries into 14 yards and a touchdown and hauled in all four of his targets for 25 yards during the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: It looked like Chase Brown found the end zone in the fourth quarter for his third score of the game, but replay assist revealed that his knee came down just short of the goal line. Perine came in on the next play and took the ball for a one-yard touchdown to extend the Bengals' lead to 38-10 following Evan MacPherson's successful extra-point try. It was Perine's third touchdown of the season and first since Week 7 against the Ravens, and over his last five games, he has turned 39 carries into 151 yards (3.9 YPC) and two touchdowns while adding seven catches on as many targets for 44 yards and a score. He'll continue to operate as the Bengals' RB2 behind Brown heading into Week 11 against the Commanders on Monday, Nov. 23.

inj_report.short: Andrews brought in all eight targets for 82 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday.
inj_report.long: According to Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site, Andrews confirmed after Monday's game that he's been playing through a broken left hand since Week 3, but he finally appears to be back to full health. Though he didn't miss any time due to broken hand, he was listed on the injury report from Weeks 4 through 9 before avoiding the report entirely for Week 10. He proceeded to deliver a season-best performance in starting quarterback Jacoby Brissett's team debut, eclipsing his previous-best mark in receiving yardage by 33 yards. Andrews' instant chemistry with Brissett was certainly encouraging after the Ravens' passing attack's moribund state over the prior two contests, and the veteran tight end could continue thriving in a Week 11 road matchup against the Panthers, especially now that he appears to have fully healed up from the hand injury.

inj_report.short: Hill turned three carries into four yards and added five catches on seven targets for 34 yards during the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday.
inj_report.long: Hill also had a 14-yard carry midway through the first quarter, but the play was nullified by an offensive holding call. The veteran running back connected on a 17-yard catch with Jacoby Brissett late in the third, which set up a 36-yard field goal by Riley Patterson four plays later. Hill's five catches were a season high, and even with the Ravens' quarterback carousel over the last three weeks, the 2019 fourth-rounder has hauled in at least three passes in each of his last five outings. Losers of five straight games, the Ravens will look to turn their fortunes around in a Week 11 road tilt against the Panthers on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Raymond caught four passes for 32 yards on seven targets in Sunday night's 27-24 win over the Bucs.
inj_report.long: Raymond tied Rome Odunze for second on the team in targets behind Luther Burden (nine), but Burden was injured late in the fourth quarter. If he needs to miss any time, Raymond projects to see elevated snaps alongside Odunze and Colston Loveland. The good news for Burden is he'll have two weeks to heal up with the Bears headed into their bye in Week 10.

inj_report.short: Washington caught one pass for five yards on two targets in Sunday night's loss to the Bengals.
inj_report.long: Aaron Rodgers threw for 143 yards in the game, and most of that came in garbage time in the second half with the score already out of hand. Washington has fewer than 30 receiving yards in seven of nine games played this season and is the epitome of a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option at tight end.

inj_report.short: Vidal turned two carries into zero yards, brought in both of his targets for 14 yards and returned one kickoff for 32 yards during the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday.
inj_report.long: Vidal's 15 offensive snaps were just ahead of Keaton Mitchell's 13, but both running backs took a back seat to Omarion Hampton, who was on the field for 36 of the Chargers' 57 snaps on offense and led the backfield with 22 carries for 105 yards and one touchdown. Vidal's two carries were his fewest since Week 3 against the Bills (1), although his 15-yard catch early in the third quarter set the Chargers up just outside the red zone, with Cameron Dicker connecting on a 34-yard field goal four plays later. Vidal and Mitchell will continue to operate in rotational roles behind Hampton heading into Week 11 against the Jets on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Burks caught two of three targets for 27 yards Thursday in a 24-21 win over the Giants.
inj_report.long: Burks missed Week 9 due to a foot injury but was able to limit his absence to one game. The veteran wideout logged a 60 percent offensive snap share, third among Washington wideouts behind Stefon Diggs and Antonio Williams. Burks has a chance to take on a larger role in the Commanders' passing game with Terry McLaurin (knee) lost for the season, though Diggs and Williams may be better bets for weekly production given their higher spots in the pecking order.

inj_report.short: Otton caught four of eight targets for 25 yards in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: The tight end saw a team-high eight targets, drawing a 26.7 percent target share from Baker Mayfield. It still didn't translate into much in the box score, as Otton remains without a touchdown through nine games. He's turned 38 targets into 23 catches for 211 yards this season and is a low-floor fantasy option most weeks.

inj_report.short: Boutte failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
inj_report.long: Even with Marvin Harrison (hamstring) out and Jaylin Noel (toe) done for the season, Boutte was targeted on just one of C.J. Stroud's 38 pass attempts versus Cleveland. Boutte's 47 snaps on offense were fewer than both Nico Collins (57) and Xavier Hutchinson (51) but 14 more than Tank Dell, though Dell out-targeted Boutte four to one. Boutte popped off for 4-125-2 in Week 9 against the Chargers but otherwise has failed to reach 40 receiving yards in any of his eight other appearances this season.

inj_report.short: Bernard failed to reel in any of his three targets while notching a 10-yard rush during Sunday night's 38-18 loss to the Bengals.
inj_report.long: Bernard went without a catch for the first time since Week 1, and his three targets were his fewest since the team's Week 4 loss to the Browns. The wide receiver led his position in offensive snaps (58), besting DK Metcalf (50) in that regard. Bernard entered Week 10 having recorded multiple receptions in five straight contests, and he'll have a good shot to get back on track in Week 11 versus the Eagles.

inj_report.short: Worthy failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: Worthy ran a team-high 37 routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks, but on a day Mahomes targeted nine different players, Worthy was the only one to not record a catch. With Josh Downs now in the fold and working to get comfortable in the offense, Worthy's role will likely only continue to shrink. On just eight routes in his team debut Sunday, Downs posted a 4-53-1 receiving line on five targets. Worthy hasn't produced that many fantasy points in a game all season. He's waiver-wire fodder in 12-team redraft leagues.

inj_report.short: Dulcich failed to haul in either of his two targets while logging 42 of 69 offensive snaps in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Second-year signal-caller Kyle McCord threw for 209 yards on 32 attempts in his first NFL start, but he couldn't forge much of a connection with Dulcich, who was held without a catch for the second time this season. With Malik Willis (core) out for at least three more contests while on injured reserve, Dulcich will have more time to build a rapport with McCord, but the tight end was far from a reliable fantasy option even when Willis was directing the offense. Despite playing more than 50 percent of the offensive snaps in each of the Dolphins' nine games, Dulcich has been limited to 24 receptions for 270 yards and has yet to find the end zone.

inj_report.short: Taylor caught all four of his targets for 20 yards during the Jets' 31-12 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Taylor's four catches were tied with Breece Hall and Isaiah Williams for second most on the Jets behind Garrett Wilson, who turned 14 targets into a 7-106-1 line. It was the third time this season that Taylor recorded at least four catches, with his last instance being Week 7 against the Dolphins (five receptions). The second-year tight end has a 22-167-2 line on 29 targets through eight regular-season games heading into Week 11 against the Chargers on Nov. 22.

inj_report.long: Lane was far from efficient during his first opportunity to work with new quarterback Jacoby Brissett, but he parlayed his career-high target total into a career-best yardage tally. The fact the rookie third-round pick garnered so much of Brissett's attention was certainly encouraging, and Lane could emerge as a much more consistent No. 3 option in the offense in coming weeks.

inj_report.short: Johnson caught two passes for 76 yards on five targets in Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Johnson accounted for the Bucs' longest play of the game, producing a 58-yard catch-and-run to lead the team in receiving yards. Johnson has been working as the Bucs' WR3 behind Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin, with rookie Ted Hurst mixing in for sub-package snaps. Johnson isn't a particularly exciting fantasy bet.

inj_report.short: Treadwell caught three passes on as many targets for 24 yards and a touchdown during Indianapolis' 24-22 win over Miami on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Week 10 was the Colts' first game without Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, who were traded to the Chiefs and 49ers, respectively, on Tuesday. Treadwell led all Colts wide receivers with three catches and 52 offensive snaps, and he connected with Daniel Jones for a seven-yard touchdown pass late in the second quarter to give Indianapolis a 14-7 halftime lead. It was the first time Treadwell found the end zone this season, and the 2016 first-rounder figures to maintain a larger role in the offense given the departure of the Colts' top targets at the trade deadline. The Colts will hit the road for Week 11 against the Texans on Thursday, and Houston's defense ranks 28th in the NFL in fantasy points allowed per game to opposing wide receivers.

inj_report.short: Fields brought in three of four targets for 62 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.
inj_report.long: The rookie finished a distant second in receiving yards to Isaiah Likely for the Giants on the night, but Fields' yardage total was the second highest of his nascent career. Fields has at least three catches in three consecutive games after opening his career with six straight two-reception efforts, and the Notre Dame product will look to continue cultivating his chemistry with J.J. McCarthy in a Week 11 home matchup against the Jaguars on Sunday, Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: McGowan rushed 12 times for 77 yards and a touchdown and returned two kickoffs for 61 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
inj_report.long: The rookie had shown well in recent weeks while trade speculation swirled around Jonathan Taylor, and even though the latter ultimately stayed put at the deadline, McGowan still compiled a new career high in rush attempts and rushing yards. The Kentucky product also followed up his first career rushing touchdown in Week 9 against the Cowboys with a four-yard scoring run early in the second quarter Sunday, and McGowan was also productive in his returner role. While Taylor should remain the de facto top backfield option for the Colts, McGowan should remain in an elevated role for what remains of Indianapolis' non-contending season.

inj_report.short: Kamra rushed two times for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He added three catches for 10 yards and an additional touchdown on four targets.
inj_report.long: With Travis Etienne back from his weeks-long hamstring injury that saw him miss five games while on injured reserve, the Saints deployed a three-man backfield committee against Carolina. Kamara scored a couple touchdowns, but it was a fluky performance on just five touches and 16 offensive snaps. Audric Estime logged 27 snaps and handled eight touches, while Etienne played 21 snaps and touched the ball 11 times. This is a backfield to avoid in fantasy while it the trio cancels each other out and caps each others' upside.

inj_report.short: Dulin caught one of two targets for 30 yards and returned three kickoffs for 77 yards during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also recorded two tackles on special teams.
inj_report.long: Even with Josh Downs and Keenan Allen being sent out at the Nov. 10 trade deadline, Dulin's 13 offensive snaps were fourth-most among Colts wide receivers behind Laquon Treadwell (52), Deion Burks (34) and Anthony Gould (32). Dulin did connect on a 30-yard pass from Daniel Jones on a 30-yard pass late in the second quarter, which was a pivotal part of the Colts' nine-play, 92-yard drive that ended with a seven-yard touchdown catch by Treadwell. Dulin has logged catches of 55 and 30 yards in each of his last two outings, and he could be the Colts' WR3 for Thursday's AFC South tilt against the Texans if Gould is not cleared to play due to a toe injury.

inj_report.short: Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Most of Gainwell's 76 scrimmage yards came on a 44-yard catch. He has 304 scrimmage yards over the past three games after recording just 122 scrimmage yards across his first six outings for the Buccaneers. Bucky Irving rushed for two touchdowns Sunday and remains the top option in Tampa Bay's backfield, but Gainwell has started to make the most of his change-of-pace role in the Buccaneers' run-heavy offense. Gainwell will try to pick up where he left off in Week 11 against the Lions after a Week 10 bye.

inj_report.short: Johnson caught his only target for four yards in a 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
inj_report.long: For the third time in seven appearances this season, Johnson didn't log a single carry. The veteran running back also didn't have much of a role in the passing game with just one target. In fact, Johnson tallied just 10 offensive snaps, finishing behind both starter James Cook (35) and fellow backup Ray Davis (12). Johnson has had a few productive performances as a pass catcher this season, but his role is too unpredictable to warrant weekly fantasy consideration.

inj_report.short: Helm caught all four of his targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
inj_report.long: After a career day last time out in Week 8 against the Bengals, Helm's box score looked more familiar against Jacksonville's stout defense. He's been held below 30 yards in eight of nine games this season and has yet to catch a touchdown. Helm is a member of the large bucket of low-floor TE2 options in fantasy.

inj_report.short: Engram caught four of five targets for 33 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.
inj_report.long: The four catches matched Engram's season high, and his 33 yards were his most since Week 5. It goes without saying, but Engram is well off the fantasy radar at tight end. He has 17 catches for 169 yards and one touchdown through nine games, averaging a career-low 18.8 yards per contest.

inj_report.short: Mitchell turned three carries into four yards, failed to haul in his lone target and returned two kickoffs for 30 yards during the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday.
inj_report.long: One of Mitchell's carries went for 11 yards, but his other two rushes went for minus-five and minus-two yards, and all of those touches came on the same drive in the second quarter. His 13 offensive snaps were third-most among Chargers running backs behind Kimani Vidal (15) and Omarion Hampton (36), and it was Hampton that commanded the majority of backfield touches, finishing with 22 carries for 105 yards and a touchdown. Mitchell has logged four carries or fewer in three of his last four outings, and he'll continue to operate in a rotational role on offense heading into the Chargers' Week 11 home tilt against the Jets on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Higgins played 24 of 35 offensive snaps (68.6 percent) but didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Week 10 was Higgins' first game since signing a three-year extension worth up to $26.8 million, which puts him under contract with the Cardinals through the 2029 season. He didn't have any offensive stats to show for it during Sunday's loss, although the Cardinals finished with a 17:37 time of possession, and the offense struggled as a whole with rookie third-round quarterback Carson Beck under center for the first time this season. Higgins will take an 18-162-1 receiving line on 20 targets through 10 regular-season games into Arizona's Week 11 tilt against Kansas City on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Rodriguez rushed for five yards on four carries in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: Rodriguez was out-carried 26 to four by Bhayshul Tuten, who has very much proven himself as the Jaguars' clear RB1 in one of the league's best offenses. Tuten also out-snapped Rodriguez 52 to 10, while LeQuint Allen (12 snaps) saw more playing time. Rodriguez is little more than a deep-league bench stash should something happen to Tuten.

Allen and Brock Purdy seemed to have instant chemistry despite having practiced on only three occasions coming into the contest, and the veteran receiver's production should have a good chance of spiking further down the stretch of the regular season.

Tremble has yet to reach 50 receiving yards in a game this season, and his four catches matched his season high. More of a blocker and red-zone specialist, Tremble has very little fantasy appeal in a Carolina offense that likes to use three tight ends.

inj_report.short: Vele caught both of his targets for 14 yards during the Saints' 20-17 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Vele was on the field for 55 of the Saints' 63 offensive snaps, which was second most among wide receivers behind Chris Olave (56). Despite that playing time, Vele saw only two targets Sunday, although no other Saints pass catcher logged more than three receptions other than rookie first-rounder Jordyn Tyson, who finished with 11 catches on 13 targets for 80 yards. Vele has two receptions in each of his last two outings, and it appears his role in the Saints' passing offense has shrunk due to the return of Tyson. Vele will look to bounce back for Week 11 against the Bears on Nov. 22, and Chicago's defense ranks 15th in the NFL in fantasy points allowed to receivers per game.

inj_report.short: Sadiq was limited to a three-yard reception on two targets in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
inj_report.long: On a day in which quarterbacks Geno Smith (ankle) and Cade Klubnik dropped back 45 times, Sadiq wasn't able to see much involvement in the passing game. Though the rookie first-round pick put his pass-catching chops on display with a 7-105-1 receiving line in Week 3 against Detroit, he's since delivered a collective 10-95-0 line on 19 targets over the Jets' ensuing seven contests. A lack of extended playing time has been a factor in Sadiq's listless production of late; he's logged fewer than 50 percent of the offensive snaps in five of those seven games while second-year tight end Mason Taylor typically has handled larger snap shares.

Lemon has operated as Philadelphia's de facto No. 1 WR while DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) have both missed the past three games, but the Eagles could get at least one of their top two wideouts back in Week 11 against the Steelers following a Week 10 bye.

The wideout was operating in a more prominent offensive role for the second week in a row with Jauan Jennings (calf) sidelined, and fellow wide receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) was unable to play as well. Addison now is expected to undergo thumb surgery, opening the door for Price to operate in an elevated position in Minnesota's offense for the time being.

The veteran wideout also recorded multiple receptions for the first time in three games, and two of his three catches went for first downs. Bateman seemed to lay a solid foundation with his new signal-caller, and he'll look to continue building on it in a Week 11 road matchup against the Panthers.

inj_report.long: Gadsden went to the locker room during the first half of Monday's game after being poked in the ye, but the second-year tight end was cleared to return for the second quarter. However, his 12 offensive snaps were his lowest since Week 1 against the Cardinals (10), and that lack of playing time coincided with the return of veteran tight end David Njoku, who missed the Chargers' six prior games while on IR due to a fibula injury. Njoku and Charlie Kolar appear to be the Chargers' top options at tight end, and the return of the latter has squeezed Gadsden out of the gameplan ahead of Week 11 against the Jets on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Felton is on track to operate in a more prominent role in Week 11 versus the 49ers, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Felton drew a start in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers, reeling in a season-high three of five targets for 33 yards over 56 offensive snaps. The wide receiver stepped into a starting role as a result of Jordan Addison (thumb) and Jauan Jennings (calf) being sidelined, and Addison is now reportedly set to undergo surgery to address his injury, opening the door for more opportunities for Felton moving forward.

inj_report.short: The Colts listed Gould (toe) as a limited participant in Tuesday's walk-through practice.
inj_report.long: Indianapolis has now estimated Gould as limited on both of its first two practice reports of Week 11, after he emerged from Sunday's 24-22 win over the Dolphins with the toe injury. His status for Thursday's game against the Texans is muddled for the moment, but Gould could clear up any concern about his availability by turning in a full practice Wednesday. After Indianapolis shipped out two receivers (Keenan Allen and Josh Downs) at the trade deadline, Gould stepped in as the Colts' top option in the slot in Week 10 and finished with two receptions for 28 yards on four targets.

inj_report.short: Estime carried the ball seven times for six yards and caught his only target for five yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to Carolina.
inj_report.long: Travis Etienne returned from IR and led the Saints' backfield with 11 touches, although he managed just 34 scrimmage yards, while Alvin Kamara handled five touches and scored two short TDs. Perhaps worse for Estime's role and future value, he was ineffective in short-yardage situations, getting stuffed on three attempts to pick up a first down from two yards out or less, and a miscommunication with Tyler Shough on a handoff led to a lost fumble in the second quarter, although the giveaway was charged to the QB. Estime will try to maintain some share of the workload in a Week 11 meeting with the Bears.

inj_report.short: Abanikanda reverted to the Cowboys' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
inj_report.long: Abanikanda made his 2026 regular-season debut against the 49ers in Week 10, when he operated as the Cowboys' RB2 behind Javonte Williams. Abanikanda finished that contest with two carries for eight yards and a two-yard catch on his lone target in what ended as a 46-40 loss for Dallas. With both Tyler Goodson (knee) and Malik Davis (hip) on injured reserve, Abanikanda figures to be elevated to the Cowboys' active roster for Week 11 against the Titans on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Sample caught all three of his targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-18 win against Pittsburgh.
inj_report.long: Sample entered the contest with no catches over his previous two games, but he tied season-high marks in both receptions and targets versus the Steelers. He gave Cincinnati a two-score lead just after the beginning of the second quarter when he hauled in a three-yard TD from Joe Burrow. Sample has two touchdowns over his past four games, but with just five catches for 39 yards during that span, he's almost entirely dependent on getting into the end zone to generate useful fantasy production.

inj_report.short: Ekeler rushed nine times for 26 yards and brought in all four targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.
inj_report.long: As his final line indicates, Ekeler retained a solid level of involvement in the narrow win, logging a season-high 13 touches. He posted a new season high in receiving yards along the way, and the veteran back has proven to be a solid complement to Rachaad White while Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin, IR) has been sidelined. However, with the latter potentially set to return as soon as Week 11's home matchup against the Bengals, Ekeler could be headed to a reduced role.

inj_report.short: Black rushed 11 times for 53 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys. He added two catches for 13 yards on two targets.
inj_report.long: The rookie running back has tallied double-digit carries in three straight games and played 26 of 65 offensive snaps behind Christian McCaffrey's 39 snaps. CMC was also extremely productive out of the backfield against Dallas' Swiss-cheese defense, turning 17 touches into 243 total yards and three touchdowns. Black is more involved than most of McCaffrey's backups have been in recent seasons, and the rookie is offering some standalone RB2/3 valuation in one of the league's most efficient offenses. Over the last three games, Black has rushed 34 times for 186 yards (5.5 YPC) and two touchdowns.

inj_report.short: Singletary played just five snaps on offense and took one carry for three yards in Thursday's 24-21 loss to the Commanders.
inj_report.long: Cam Skattebo came back from a hamstring injury and dominated backfield work, taking 21 touches for 122 yards and two touchdowns on an 88 percent snap share. Singletary played 92 percent of snaps the week before in a win at Philadelphia, but his 23 touches went for just 39 total yards and no TDs. It'll likely be another large workload for Skattebo when the Giants host the Jaguars in Week 11.

inj_report.long: Njoku's snap count Monday was predictably capped, seeing as he was on injured reserve for the Chargers' six prior games while recovering from a fibula injury that he sustained in Week 2 against the Raiders. His 19 offensive snaps were actually ahead of Oronde Gadsden (12), with Charlie Kolar leading all Chargers tight ends with 41 snaps on offense. Njoku could see more involvement in the Chargers' passing attack in Week 11 against the Jets on Sunday.

inj_report.long: Brooks ended Week 10 prep with back-to-back limited practices, but he was tagged as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Panthers. The third-year running back is not quite fully recovered from a groin injury that landed him on IR in late September, so his next chance to suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Trevor Etienne, AJ Dillon and Anthony Tyus will continue to operate in rotational backfield roles behind Chuba Hubbard while Brooks is sidelined.

inj_report.short: Mims caught one of two targets for zero yards, added a five-yard carry and returned three punts for 22 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Nineteen of Mims' 24 snaps came on offense, although he logged only two touches in the process. He hasn't seen more than four targets in a game this season, with most of his output coming on special teams as a returner on both kickoffs and punts. The Broncos are on a bye for Week 10, so their next game will take place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22

inj_report.short: Virgil was on the field for 16 of the Cardinals' 35 offensive snaps (45.7 percent), but the rookie fifth-rounder didn't show up on the box score otherwise during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: The Cardinals' offense struggled in its first game this season with rookie third-round quarterback Carson Beck under center, and Arizona finished with a 17:37 time of possession. That meant less opportunities for Virgil and the rest of the Cardinals pass catchers, and even star tight end Trey McBride finished with only five catches on as many targets for 37 yards. It's hard to put much trust into Virgil and the rest of the Cardinals skill-position players (other than McBride), especially with the team heading into a tough Week 11 road tilt against the Chiefs.

inj_report.short: Gray caught one of three targets for six yards during Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: Gray was unable to reel in multiple passes for the second straight week after he had at least two catches in each of the team's previous five games prior to Week 9. The tight end did play a season-high 53 offensive snaps with Travis Kelce being limited to just 18 snaps on offense as a result of an ankle injury. If Kelce is forced to be limited or even miss the team's Week 11 matchup with Arizona, Gray would stand to operate as the team's primary tight end in his place.

inj_report.short: Coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that the Steelers are "hopeful" they can get Pittman -- who last played in Week 4 -- back from his foot injury this week, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.
inj_report.long: The same goes for Roman Wilson (finger), who saw his last game action in Week 5. In the duo's absence, DK Metcalf has led Pittsburgh's WR corps, with Germie Bernard having seen his role expand in the process. Prior to his injury, Pittman caught seven of his 12 targets for 89 yards in three games, but once he rejoins the lineup, the 29-year-old -- who had at least 111 targets in each of his last five seasons with the Colts -- could resurface on the fantasy radar in PPR formats.

inj_report.short: Vaki turned six carries into 28 yards and added a 17-yard catch on his only target during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
inj_report.long: Lead back Jahmyr Gibbs dominated with 252 yards and three touchdowns on 29 total touches (22 carries, seven catches on eight targets), but Vaki also had his moments during Sunday's game, including a 17-yard catch on the first play of the second quarter. Vaki was working through an ankle issue during Week 10 prep before being cleared to play, and he'll continue to operate in a rotational role in the backfield behind Gibbs. Through eight regular-season games, Vaki has turned 36 carries into 163 yards (4.5 YPC) and eight catches on nine targets for 81 yards. The Lions will be at home for three of their next four games, starting with Week 11 against the Buccaneers on Nov. 22.

inj_report.long: Fant didn't connect with Tyler Shough on a short pass late in the first quarter, and that ended up being the only target for the veteran tight end. Fant has a 12-96-3 line on 19 targets through eight regular-season games, although he's logged one reception or zero in four of his last five outings. He doesn't have much fantasy appeal as the Saints' TE2 behind Juwan Johnson heading into Week 11 against the Bears on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Burks failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also recorded one tackle on special teams.
inj_report.long: With Josh Downs and Keenan Allen being shipped off to the Chiefs and 49ers, respectively, at the Nov. 10 deadline, the Colts turned to Burks, Laquon Treadwell and Anthony Gould to serve as the top wideouts for Week 10. Burks' 34 offensive snaps were a season high and second among Indianapolis' wide receivers, but the rookie seventh-rounder failed to record a catch for the fifth time in 10 regular-season games, with one of his intended passes from Daniel Jones being intercepted by Michael Taaffe midway through the second quarter. Gould is working through a toe injury, so Burks could step into a bigger role on offense if the former is unable to play against the Texans on Thursday.

inj_report.short: Fehoko finished Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams with one catch on two targets for 21 yards. He also recorded a tackle.
inj_report.long: Week 10 was the Cardinals' first game with rookie third-rounder Carson Beck on the field. The offense struggled to move the ball down the field and logged only 35 snaps as a whole while finishing with a 17:37 time of possession. That meant less opportunities for Fehoko and the rest of the Cardinals' skill-position players, although the sixth-year pro did connect with Beck on a 21-yard pass early in the first quarter. Fehoko's 26 offensive snaps led all Arizona wide receivers, and with Michael Wilson (neck, IR) out for the rest of the season, the former should continue to operate in an elevated role heading into Week 11 against the Chiefs on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Kolar caught two of three passes for 16 yards during the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday.
inj_report.long: Kolar's 41 offensive snaps were by far the most among Chargers tight ends, well ahead of a returning David Njoku (19) and Oronde Gadsden (12), although the latter briefly left Monday's game due to an eye injury. That said, Kolar was held to two catches or fewer for the second time in three games, and he has not seen a red zone target from Justin Herbert since Week 6 against the Chiefs. Kolar has amassed a 15-145-0 receiving line on 23 targets across seven regular-season games heading into Week 11 against the Jets on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Thomas caught three of four targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: The three catches tied his season high, while the four targets represented his biggest volume since Week 2. The Jaguars' decision not to deal Thomas at the trade deadline remains a curious one, as the third-year wideout simply doesn't have a significant role in Liam Coen's offense and might not step into one even if someone like Parker Washington got injured -- Josh Cameron was more productive Sunday on three targets and caught one of Trevor Lawrence's three TDs. Thomas will take a 13-146-2 line on 26 targets over nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Giants.

inj_report.short: TeSlaa caught two of five targets for 19 yards and a touchdown during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle.
inj_report.long: It was a quiet day for TeSlaa, with the Lions' offense being powered by usual suspects Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs, with the latter duo combining for four touchdowns (three receiving, one rushing). TeSlaa was the other Lions player to find the end zone, which took place early in the second quarter on a 12-yard touchdown pass from Jared Goff. It was the first touchdown catch of the season for TeSlaa, who found the end zone six times across 17 regular-season games during his rookie campaign in 2025. He has been the Lions' distant WR3 behind St. Brown and Jameson Williams, and that shouldn't change ahead of the team's Week 11 tilt against the Buccaneers on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Cameron caught all three of his targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23, Week 10 win over Tennessee. He also returned five kickoffs for 142 yards.
inj_report.long: Cameron gave the Jaguars a 14-point lead early in the fourth quarter when he hauled in a 25-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. It was the rookie wideout's third touchdown of the campaign but his first since Week 3. Cameron's 67 receiving yards marked a career high, while his three receptions tied the most he's had as a pro. Cameron's propensity for finding the end zone (his three TDs have come on just 12 total catches) is appealing, but at this point he isn't getting enough volume to be a reliable week-to-week fantasy asset.

inj_report.short: Knox caught one of his three targets for seven yards in the Bills' 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Knox continues to receive targets as the No. 2 tight end in the Bills offense. The 30-year-old has consistently struggled to bring in catchable balls over the past few contests but remains a valuable part of Buffalo's 13-personnel packages as a blocker and receiving threat. Knox played 41 offensive snaps in Sunday's game and was on the field for 72 percent of the Bills' offensive plays.

inj_report.short: Schoonmaker caught one of two targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 46-40 loss to the 49ers.
inj_report.long: Schoonmaker garnered a season-high two targets, but he failed to produce his first multi-catch performance of the year. The tight end played 28 offensive snaps in contest, ranking second at his position behind Brevyn Spann-Ford (55) and ahead of James Mitchell (five). With Jake Ferguson (knee) expected to remain sidelined in Week 11, Schoonmaker will have another chance to operate as the team's top reserve option at tight end versus the Titans on Sunday.

inj_report.short: The Eagles opened Shipley's (foot) 21-day practice window Monday.
inj_report.long: Shipley landed on IR after being diagnosed with a partial tear of his plantar fascia in the wake of Week 5 action, but he now has a chance to play as soon as Sunday against the Steelers. Meanwhile, fellow RB Tank Bigsby (abdomen) -- who hasn't played since Week 4 -- remains on IR, and the Eagles signed Jaydon Blue to their practice squad Monday. If Shipley is able to suit up this weekend, he'll reclaim a backup role behind Saquon Barkley that isn't likely to result in much volume for the 2024 fourth-rounder.

inj_report.short: Ogunbowale reverted to the Texans' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
inj_report.long: Ogunbowale was elevated to the active roster to operate as a depth option in the backfield behind Woody Marks (concussion) in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns. The running back rushed one time for two yards while reeling in his only target for 13 yards in the defeat. With Marks potentially sidelined with a concussion and David Montgomery (groin) uncertain for Week 11, Ogunbowale could be elevated again ahead of Thursday night's matchup with the Colts.

inj_report.short: Evans caught both of his two targets for 20 yards during Sunday's 26-21 loss versus the Broncos.
inj_report.long: For the third game in a row, Evans drew exactly two targets and caught both of them Sunday. With that said, he also again trailed in snaps at tight end (31) behind teammates Tommy Tremble (46) and Darren Waller (35), both of whom also drew more targets in Week 9. Evans' role in the Panthers' passing offense isn't big enough to warrant fantasy consideration in most formats going into a Week 10 matchup at New Orleans.

inj_report.short: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said that he's "hopeful" Wilson (finger) will be able to return from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.
inj_report.long: Now that he's spent the required four games on IR while recovering from a finger injury, Wilson is eligible to have his 21-day practice window opened this week. McCarthy expressed similar optimism that fellow wideout Michael Pittman (foot) will be able to come off IR this week, a development that could result in Wilson settling for a lesser role if both receivers are activated ahead of Sunday's contest. Despite a rough start to the season, Pittman signed a two-year, $35 million extension in March that likely affords him some security as a starter alongside DK Metcalf upon his return, which would leave Wilson to fend with rookie second-round pick Germie Bernard for the No. 3 spot on the depth chart.

inj_report.short: Johnson logged one catch (on three targets) for eight yards Thursday in a loss to the Commanders.
inj_report.long: Johnson hasn't been able to get going in 2026, as he's finished with one or zero catches in six of his seven games so far. After working as New York's top tight end last season, he's been mostly an afterthought in the current campaign due to the arrival of Isaiah Likely, who went off for a 9-127-1 line on a team-leading 11 targets Thursday. As long as Likely is healthy, Johnson won't have much appeal in most fantasy formats.

inj_report.short: Thomas hauled in one of his two targets for 13 yards and returned three kicks for 88 yards during Chicago's win versus Tampa Bay on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Thomas continues to see limited action offensively, playing just five snaps Sunday and no more than 15 on offense in any game this season, though he did manage to record his seventh reception of the season. The rookie third-round pick should continue to see the majority of his action come on special teams, and he's now amassed 715 kick-return yards across nine outings this season.

inj_report.short: Bech caught two of seven targets for 10 yards during the Raiders' 21-13 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Bech was the favorite target of rookie first-overall pick Fernando Mendoza, who was making his first career start Sunday after the Raiders shipped Kirk Cousins to the Vikings at the Nov. 10 trade deadline. Bech's seven targets were a season high, but he mustered only two catches for his efforts, and he failed to connect on each of the last four passes he saw from Mendoza in the fourth quarter. The volume appears to be there for Bech, and he could take on a larger role offensively in Week 11 against the Broncos on Nov. 22 if star tight end Brock Bowers (ankle) is unable to play.

inj_report.short: Restrepo was signed to the Titans' active roster Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.
inj_report.long: Restrepo was elevated to the active roster in Week 10 against the Jaguars, and he reeled in all three of his targets for 31 yards over 19 offensive snaps. After fellow wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Restrepo will replace him on the active roster ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Cowboys.

inj_report.short: Mooney caught two of five targets for eight yards Thursday in a loss to Washington.
inj_report.long: Mooney logged the third-most targets of any New York pass catcher, but he managed just two short receptions. Efficiency has been an issue for the veteran wideout throughout the campaign, as he's hauled in only 14 of 30 targets through nine contests. Mooney has finished with fewer than 10 yards in four of his past six appearances, so he's not a viable fantasy play at the moment.

inj_report.short: Nailor recorded one reception for minus-1 yard on four targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.
inj_report.long: Making his first NFL start, No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza was under siege throughout the afternoon, as a ferocious Seahawks defense sacked him six times and limited him to just 143 passing yards on 29 attempts. As a result, Nailor and the Raiders' other pass catchers were held quiet, with running back Ashton Jeanty (four receptions for 46 yards) being the only Las Vegas player to top two catches and 25 receiving yards. Though Mendoza will get some more favorable matchups over the Raiders' final seven games, Nailor will be difficult to count on for production. Even while Kirk Cousins served as the starting quarterback for Las Vegas before being traded to the Vikings last week, Nailor was limited to just 14 receptions for 122 yards and one touchdown on 28 targets through eight appearances.

inj_report.short: Duvernay caught two of three targets for 35 yards during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Duvernay was on the field for only 10 of the Cardinals' 35 offensive snaps (28.6 percent), but the veteran wide receiver connected with rookie third-round quarterback Carson Beck on passes of four and 31 yards on back-to-back plays late in the first quarter. Duvernay finished the contest second in catches, targets and receiving yards behind Trey McBride, and the former has caught two passes in each of his last three outings. With Michael Wilson (neck, IR) out for the year, the Cardinals' top wideouts for the rest of the season appear to be Duvernay, Simi Fehoko and rookie fifth-rounder Reggie Virgil, which doesn't bring much confidence heading into Week 11 against the Chiefs on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Trautman caught two of three passes for 15 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Trautman failed to record a catch across six games between Weeks 2 and 7, but he has logged two receptions in each of his two outings. His 41 offensive snaps ended up being ahead of fellow tight end Evan Engram (38), although the latter has been more involved in the Broncos' offensive game plan than Trautman. The Broncos' next game takes place in Week 11 against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Mitchell reverted to the Eagles' practice squad Monday.
inj_report.long: Mitchell has been elevated each of the past three weeks and has logged at least six touches in every game during that span. During this past Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants, he recorded six yards on three carries and caught three passes for 20 yards on four targets. The Eagles would need to sign Mitchell to the 53-man roster in order for him to be eligible to play in their next game, which will be Nov. 22 versus Pittsburgh following a Week 10 bye. That opportunity for Mitchell could depend on whether Tank Bigsby (abdomen) and/or Will Shipley (foot) return from injured reserve.

inj_report.short: Roush caught both of his two targets for 23 yards during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Buccaneers.
inj_report.long: Roush, who has been utilized heavily as a blocker through nine games, achieved a new career high in receiving yards in Week 9. Roush has been relatively efficient with his limited targets so far this season, but Colston Loveland should be expected to continue to handle a substantial majority of the Bears' pass-catching duties at tight end as long as he's available.

inj_report.short: Turpin caught one of three targets for 10 yards Sunday in a Week 10 loss to San Francisco. He also rushed once for nine yards.
inj_report.long: Dak Prescott took to the air 51 times in the offensive slugfest, but Turpin got only three of his targets. Meanwhile, George Pickens drew a whopping 18 looks, CeeDee Lamb got 13 and Ryan Flournoy got seven, and all three of those wideouts scored at least one touchdown. Turpin logged a 17 percent offensive snap share in his return from a three-game absence caused by an injury to his ribs. He's fallen below a 20 percent offensive snap share in all but one of his seven appearances this season, so Turpin seems to be steadfastly locked into no higher than Dallas' No. 4 wideout role.

inj_report.short: Meyers caught both of his targets for 20 yards and a touchdown while also adding 58 yards as a kick returner during Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
inj_report.long: Meyers reeled in multiple passes for the third straight game, and he was able to secure his first score of the year in the second quarter on a 15-yard touchdown pass from Joe Burrow. The 26-year-old's 28 offensive snaps ranked fourth at wide receiver for Cincinnati behind Ja'Marr Chase (59), Tee Higgins (51) and Colbie Young (29). With Andrei Iosivas (thumb) nearing a return to action, Meyers may see a sharp drop in offensive opportunities in the near future.

inj_report.short: Franklin brought in three of four targets for 31 yards during the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Franklin drew a 27-yard pass interference penalty on the Broncos' second offensive play of the game, but the third-year wide receiver didn't log his first catch until early in the fourth quarter. He has operated in a rotational role for most of the season, and even with Jaylen Waddle in the league's concussion protocol, Franklin will likely maintain that workload following the Broncos' Week 10 bye.

inj_report.short: Stowers failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants.
inj_report.long: The rookie tight end ran just four routes on Joe Milton's 48 dropbacks against the G-Men. Grant Calcaterra ran just six, as the Eagles used more three-wide sets than multiple TE sets. Stowers would need a Dallas Goedert injury or trade to come into any fantasy value.

inj_report.short: Jefferson caught five of seven targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: With Terry McLaurin (knee) and Treylon Burks (foot) out for the Commanders, Jefferson played 36 of 62 offensive snaps and ran 25 routes on Jayden Daniels' 42 dropbacks. The veteran wideout was signed to the active roster from the practice squad two weeks ago and led the team in receiving against Los Angeles. If Burks needs to miss more time, Jefferson could again have a role in three-wide sets Thursday night against the Giants.

inj_report.short: Cuevas caught all three of his targets for 37 yards during Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Cuevas had an immediate connection with new starting quarterback Jacoby Brissett, reeling in at least three passes for the second time this season and the first time since Week 6. The tight end ranked fourth at his position with 11 offensive snaps, sitting behind Mark Andrews (40), Matthew Hibner (22) and Nick Vannett (14). Cuevas has now caught 13 of 16 targets for 171 yards and a touchdown over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

inj_report.long: Legette made his return to the lineup after having been sidelined since Week 2 due to a knee injury but ended up playing just two snaps on offense. He will look to be more involved during next week's matchup versus the Ravens.

inj_report.short: Wright turned three carries into minus-2 yards, caught both of his targets for 17 yards and returned four kickoffs for 88 yards during the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Wright's first touch on offense came midway through the second quarter and resulted in a carry for minus-3 yards, although he did connect with Kyle McCord for a 16-yard catch late in the third. Wright was on the field for 12 of the Dolphins' 69 offensive snaps (17.4 percent), which was far behind lead back Ollie Gordon (49 snaps). Wright is averaging only 1.6 YPC on 25 rushes through seven regular-season games, and most of his on-field impact has come on special teams as a returner on kickoffs. The Dolphins will stay on the road for Week 11 against the Bills on Nov. 22.

He's well behind Ollie Gordon and Jaylen Wright on the running back depth chart, and most of Allen's playing time in Week 11 against the Bills on Nov. 22, likely will come on special teams.

inj_report.long: The blocking specialist played 28 of 57 offensive snaps and was asked to block on 12 of those plays. His two-yard touchdown in the second quarter was Bellinger's first of the season. For the year, Bellinger has 11 grabs for 76 yards and the score on 18 targets across nine contests.

inj_report.short: The Bills did not activate Shavers (knee) from the reserve/PUP list, and he will not be available for Sunday's game against the Jets.
inj_report.long: Shavers drew the questionable tag for Sunday's game against the Jets after logging a trio of full practices during Week 10 prep. However, he was not activated from the PUP list before the 4:00 p.m. ET deadline Saturday, so he will have to wait at least one more week before making his 2026 debut. Shavers' next chance to play is Week 11 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Nov. 22.

inj_report.long: With T.J. Hockenson (wrist) inactive, Bartholomew played 53 of 69 offensive snaps against Green Bay and caught the second of Kirk Cousins' two touchdowns, scoring from 20 yards out in the fourth quarter to give Minnesota a comfortable 27-10 lead. While Ben Yurosek got the start, Bartholomew played 13 more snaps and out-targeted Yurosek four to one. Cousins has an affinity for throwing to his tight ends, so Bartholomew will be on the fantasy radar if Hockenson needs to miss more time.

The former didn't do much with the opportunity, but it was a very quiet game for the Ravens' passing game as a whole, as starting QB Joe Fagnano threw for just 60 yards. Baltimore will likely have the recently acquired Jacoby Brissett starting behind center for the team's next game (Monday, Oct. 16 versus the Chargers), but Hibner has just six catches across eight contests this season, so he's not a viable fantasy option regardless of who is throwing him the ball.

inj_report.short: The Eagles signed Ertz from the practice squad to the active roster Monday.
inj_report.long: Philadelphia is coming off a Week 10 bye, but prior to the midseason respite, there were no reported injuries in the TE group on the active roster. When the position group was depleted earlier this season, the team used elevations on Ertz from Weeks 3-5, but his snap share decreased game by game (38, 21 and 11 percent), while he hauled in three of eight targets for 22 yards in that span. Wednesday's practice report will reveal if any of Dallas Goedert, Eli Stowers, Johnny Mundt or Grant Calcaterra are banged up at the moment.

inj_report.short: Coleman logged one catch for six yards on six targets in Sunday's Week 10 loss to Indianapolis.
inj_report.long: Coleman couldn't get on the same page as QB Kyle McCord, who made his first NFL regular-season appearance. In fact, Coleman has been quiet inefficient regardless of who has thrown him the ball this year, as he has just nine receptions on 27 targets through nine games. Two of his nine catches have been touchdowns, but he's not getting enough touches to be a trustworthy fantasy option.

inj_report.short: Watkins caught two passes for 49 yards on three targets in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
inj_report.long: With Deebo Samuel still working his way back to 100 percent off his hamstring injury, Keenan Allen being eased in after his acquisition from the Colts and Mike Evans (Achilles) remaining inactive, Watkins' 44 snaps led San Francisco's wideouts. However, his three targets were a distant fourth on the team and represented just a 10.7 percent share. Allen will likely play more moving forward, and Evans is expected back in the bear future. Watkins doesn't have much fantasy appeal as an ancillary option.

inj_report.short: Hurst failed to haul in his lone target during the Buccaneers' 27-24 loss to the Bears on Sunday.
inj_report.long: For a third consecutive game, the rookie third-rounder didn't record a catch while seeing only one target. Of more concern was the fact that Hurst was on the field for only one offensive snap in Week 9 after logging at least 25 offensive snaps in each of the first eight games of the regular season. That lack of offensive playing time coincided with the return of Emeka Egbuka, although Hurst also saw less snaps than Chris Godwin (62), Tez Johnson (52) and even David Sills (six), although Sills was cut by the Buccaneers on Tuesday. With the Buccaneers on a bye for Week 10, Hurst will look for better results in Week 11 against the Lions on Sunday, Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Allen caught two of four targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
inj_report.long: The rookie wideout scored his first career touchdown by beating the cornerback on a stutter-go for a 39-yard touchdown in the third quarter. With Josh Downs still getting comfortable and learning the offense following Tuesday's acquisition from the Colts, Allen maintained a significant role on offense, playing 22 of 64 offensive snaps. Once Downs progresses from the 10 snaps he played against Atlanta, it will be interesting to see if Allen can push Xavier Worthy (zero catches on three targets across 56 snaps on Sunday) for a larger piece of the outside receiver role in Kansas City's offense.

inj_report.short: Wright caught both of his targets for 11 yards during the Lions' 35-10 win over the Patriots on Sunday in Munich.
inj_report.long: Wright tied season highs in both receiving yards and catches during Sunday's win, and his 39 snaps on offense were second-most among Lions tight ends behind Sam LaPorta (56). Wright has accumulated seven catches on eight target for 42 yards across nine regular-season games, and he's mostly served as a blocking tight end on the Lions' offense.

inj_report.short: Cooper caught just two of eight targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants.
inj_report.long: With DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) still out, Cooper played more than 90 percent of the offensive snaps for the third straight game. He's done very little with that playing time, producing five catches for 61 yards during that span. Cooper is well off the fantasy radar until he shows something in the box score, and that's if Smith and Wicks remain sidelined.

inj_report.short: Allen went without a carry or target while playing 12 of the Jaguars' 73 offensive snaps in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: As a rookie seventh-round pick last season, Allen carved out a fairly consistent role as a third-down specialist, but he's struggled to earn the same level of playing time in Year 2. With Bhayshul Tuten earning more trust on passing downs and with Chris Rodriguez and Ameer Abdullah also on hand as complementary options, Allen hasn't topped a 20 percent snap share in any of the Jaguars' first nine games. Altogether, Allen has logged just one carry (for one yard) to go with two receptions for nine yards on eight targets.

inj_report.long: Smith played a season-high 47 offensive snaps (77 percent) in Week 10, and he was able to reel in multiple passes for the second time three weeks. He ranked third at his position in snaps on offense behind Germie Bernard (58) and DK Metcalf (50) while being far ahead of the next closest wideout Ben Skowronek (10). With Roman Wilson (finger) trending towards a potential activation from injured reserve  ahead of Week 11, Smith could find himself back in a limited role on offense against the Eagles on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Dallas caught his only target for a two-yard gain in Monday's Week 9 loss to the Bills.
inj_report.long: Dallas notched just eight offensive snaps but also contributed 19 snaps on special teams. The veteran running back went without a carry for the fourth time over Minnesota's past five games, indicating his lack of a role in the running game. Overall this season, Dallas has been a very small part of the Vikings' offense, recording four carries for 14 yards and five catches for 36 yards (on five targets) through eight contests.

inj_report.short: Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown Thursday in a 24-21 victory against the Giants.
inj_report.long: Sinnott gave the Commanders a lead just before halftime when he reeled in a one-yard touchdown from Jayden Daniels. It was his first TD of the season and the third of his career. Sinnott's four grabs came out of nowhere, as he'd logged just one catch on two targets through his first eight games of the season. He also ranked third among Washington tight ends Thursday with 24 offensive snaps -- behind Chig Okonkwo (41) and John Bates (28) -- so fantasy managers probably don't need to go rushing to the waiver wire to pick him up. With that said, Sinnott may have earned himself more opportunities with Thursday's effort.

inj_report.short: Tucker didn't log any offensive snaps in a loss to the Bears on Sunday. He returned four kickoffs for 92 yards.
inj_report.long: It was the second straight week in which Tucker went without an offensive snap. That's happened despite Tampa Bay going to the ground plenty during that span. Perhaps not coincidentally, Tucker has begun working as a kick returner during the two-game stretch. It appears he's not going to get many opportunities on offense as long as Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell are healthy.

inj_report.short: Williams caught four passes on seven targets for 24 yards during the Jets' 31-12 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Williams' seven targets were his most of the season, and most of those looks came after Omar Cooper left early in the first quarter of Sunday's game due to an ankle injury. The injury was to the same foot that Cooper sustained a high-ankle sprain in Week 1 against the Titans, and an extended absence of the rookie first-rounder would result in Williams stepping into the WR3 role behind Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell. The Jets will hit the road for Week 11 against the Chargers on Nov. 22.

inj_report.short: Brooks carried three times for 12 yards while taking the field for three of the Bengals' 66 offensive snaps in Sunday's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
inj_report.long: All three of Brooks' carries came during the Bengals' final possession of the fourth quarter, when the team had already built a sizable lead and opted to rest multiple key players, including top running back Chase Brown. Brooks has been active for all nine of the Bengals' games to date but has logged just six carries, all of which have come late in blowout victories. So long as Brown and Samaje Perine are both available, Brooks will continue to see limited playing time on offense.

inj_report.short: Johnson recorded two tackles on special teams during the Bears' 27-24 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) was inactive for a fifth consecutive game, with Johnson operating as the Bears' RB2 behind D'Andre Swift in the Bears' four contests prior to Sunday against the Bucs. However, Johnson didn't play a single offensive snap against Tampa Bay; instead, it was Salvon Ahmed (five carries for 25 yards) who mixed into the backfield as Chicago's complementary piece to Swift. The Bears are on a bye for Week 10, with their next game taking place in Week 11 against the Lions on Sunday, Nov. 22. Johnson would have a narrow path to offensive relevancy if Monangai is cleared to return for that contest.

inj_report.short: Young went without a target while playing one of the Raiders' 59 snaps on offense in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks. He also brought back one kickoff for 29 yards.
inj_report.long: Young has suited up in each of the Raiders' 10 games this season, but he's been deployed almost exclusively on special teams. He's seen single-digit snaps on offense in five straight games and has posted a collective 2-36-0 receiving line on three targets on the campaign.

inj_report.short: Johnson played all 17 of his snaps on special teams and recorded one tackle in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: Johnson, a reserve wide receiver, has been used almost exclusively on special teams through his two-plus seasons in Tampa Bay. He's logged just 15 total snaps on offense through nine games in 2026, recording a three-yard reception on two targets. Johnson leads the Buccaneers with 14 kickoff returns for 389 yards, but he didn't see any runback opportunities in Week 9 while Sean Tucker handled those duties.

All eight of his snaps came on special teams, and it looks like the second-year pro is out of the mix for backfield touches behind RB1 Christian McCaffrey and rookie third-rounder Kaelon Black, the latter of whom found the end zone for the second time in his last three outings. The 49ers will travel to Mexico City for Week 11 to face the Vikings on Nov. 22.

His signing gives the Cowboys extra depth at tight end, as the team will be without Jake Ferguson (knee) for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

Armstrong is not on the fantasy radar.

The second-year pro has seen action in two games with the club, recording a nine-yard catch on his only touch while racking up 268 yards on 12 kickoff returns. inj_report.short: Aubrey made both of his field-goal attempts and went 2-for-3 on extra-point tries during the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Aubrey connected on 52-yard field goals in both the first and third quarters, although his PAT in the second missed wide left. It was the second missed extra-point try of the season for Aubrey and his seventh miss overall, although five of those failed kicks have come on field-goal attempts from 50-plus yards. The Cowboys will stay home for Week 11 against the Titans, who give up 26.6 points per game (27th in the NFL) and have yielded 40-plus points in each of their last two contests.

inj_report.short: Butker made all five PATs in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Butker did not attempt a field goal in the contest, as the Chiefs solely scored touchdowns. He now moves to 27-for-28 on PATs in 2026 as he continues to struggle to hold onto the starting kicker job.

inj_report.short: Fitzgerald made two of his three field-goal attempts and both PATs in the Panthers' 20-17 win over the Saints on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Fitzgerald's 54-yard field goal as time expired iced the game for the Panthers. The kicker made another field goal from 55 yards while also missing his first attempt of the night from 48 yards out. Fitzgerald moves to 15-for-17 on field-goal attempts and 18-for-23 on PATs so far during the 2026 regular season.

inj_report.short: Ryland went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries during Sunday's 34-6 loss to the Rams.
inj_report.long: Ryland provided all of the offense for Arizona in Week 10, making multiple field goals in a contest for the fourth time in the last five weeks. The kicker has rebounded well in 2026 after a challenging 2025 campaign, converting 22 of 24 field-goal tries over 10 contests so far this season.

inj_report.short: Gay went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made his only PAT during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.
inj_report.long: Gay was able to convert multiple field goals for the sixth time this season and first time since Week 7. The kicker has now gone 21-for-23 on field-goal attempts, including 3-for-4 from 50-plus yards, while making all 22 of his extra-point tries over 10 contests so far this season.

inj_report.short: Zvada missed his only field-goal try and made all three of his PATs on Thursday in a loss to Washington.
inj_report.long: Zvada's miss was a chip-shot 33-yarder in the first quarter that sailed wide left. That proved to be a critical mistake, as the Commanders won by just three points. Zvada appeared to shore up his job security a bit by going 4-for-4 on FG tries in Week 9 against Philadelphia, but it's hard to ignore the fact that he's gone just 17-for-23 on field-goal attempts overall and has missed three kicks from under 50 yards. The rookie does have a perfect 16-for-16 mark on extra-point attempts, and head coach John Harbaugh expressed support for the inconsistent kicker Friday, saying of Zvada, "I'm confident that he's going to become a good kicker. If at some point and time it doesn't happen, it doesn't happen. But I'm not going to panic halfway through the season with a guy who has made a bunch of kicks," Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

inj_report.short: Dicker made all three of his field-goal tries and converted both of his two extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-20 win at Baltimore.
inj_report.long: Dicker's longest field goal on the day was only from 38 yards out, but there's no doubt his accuracy played a big part in the Chargers picking up their first win of the season in Week 10. He hasn't missed a kick since Week 3, but the Chargers' general inability to consistently move the ball on offense keeps him from projecting as a top-tier fantasy option in most formats going into a Week 11 matchup versus the Jets.

inj_report.short: McPherson made one of his two field-goal attempts and all five PATs in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: McPherson converted a 24-yard field-goal attempt on the first drive of the game. The kicker proceeded to miss a 43-yarder in the second quarter of the contest, though the miss did not end up mattering to the final result of the game. McPherson is now 13-for-14 on field-goal attempts and 33-for-33 on PATs over nine contests this season.

inj_report.short: McLaughlin converted all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during Tampa Bay's loss to the Bears on Sunday.
inj_report.long: McLaughlin had a solid outing despite the loss, although all three of his field goals came from within 35 yards. Across his first nine outings of the season, the 30-year-old has yet to miss a kick, converting on all 22 field-goal attempts and all 18 extra-point tries.

inj_report.short: Elliott made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants.
inj_report.long: Elliott's kick was good from 45 yards, but with Joe Milton making his first start at quarterback and without DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), the Philly offense struggled to move the ball and score points. Elliott is not an exciting fantasy kicker on a tanking Eagles team.
